phases.description: [backend-base 3/8] RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/var/cache/apt,sharing=locked     --mount=type=cache,target=/var/lib/apt,sharing=locked     rm -f /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/docker-clean     && sed -i 's|http://deb.debian.org|https://deb.debian.org|g' /etc/apt/sources.list.d/debian.sources     && apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=5 update     && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends nginx curl     && if [ "false" = "true" ]; then apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ffmpeg; fi
[frontend-deps 2/8] RUN corepack enable     && corepack prepare pnpm@11.7.0 --activate     && pnpm config set registry https://registry.npmmirror.com     && pnpm config set store-dir /pnpm/store

[python-builder 5/5] RUN --mount=type=cache,id=animetta-uv-013,target=/root/.cache/uv     uv venv --python /usr/local/bin/python /opt/venv     && uv pip sync --python /opt/venv/bin/python --compile-bytecode requirements.txt     && uv pip check --python /opt/venv/bin/python

[frontend-deps 8/8] RUN --mount=type=cache,id=animetta-pnpm-11,target=/pnpm/store     if [ "false" = "true" ]; then       pnpm --filter animetta-desktop --filter @animetta/earth install --frozen-lockfile --prefer-offline;     else       pnpm --filter animetta-desktop install --frozen-lockfile --prefer-offline;     fi
